title: Sentinel
tagline: AI-powered multi-agent DeFi swarms execute trading strategies autonomously 24/7
description: Sentinel is an autonomous DeFi agent platform that transforms trading strategies from natural language into on-chain execution. Users describe their trading intent, and AI-powered multi-agent swarms (Architect, Executor, Monitor) coordinate to validate routes via Uniswap, manage slippage and gas optimization, and execute trades when market conditions are met. The system uses a hub-and-spoke architecture with persistent agent memory in 0G Storage, reliable execution via KeeperHub, and agent tokenization through ERC-7857 iNFT contracts.
how_its_made: Sentinel combines a React/Next.js frontend with an Express.js TypeScript backend coordinating specialized AI agents. The architecture leverages 0G Storage for persistent agent state and execution history, KeeperHub MCP for reliable trade execution, Uniswap V3 Router for liquidity, ENS for agent identity discovery, and iNFT (ERC-7857) for tokenized autonomous agents. Real-time coordination uses WebSocket feeds, and agents leverage 0G Network's decentralized LLM inference for natural language strategy parsing. The system implements a modular agent framework enabling swarm-based decision making with autonomous condition monitoring.
